Above them, various bicycles hang from the ceiling, including a tiny tricycle and a large tandem bike. In the foreground, a pile of spare tires and gears sits on a workbench next to a steaming cup of coffee. A parrot perches on a shelf in the background, mimicking the sound of a ringing bell. The lighting is bright and even, with soft shadows that emphasize the smooth surfaces of the metal parts and the playful expressions of the characters. The walls are adorned with posters of famous races, adding depth and context to the busy workshop environment, while the overall composition remains balanced and visually engaging without clutter.
